contamination_risks.description: Company names appear in inconsistent formats (e.g., all caps, mixed case, abbreviations, suffixes like Ltd/Limited). Duplicate entries with slight name variations exist.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Normalize to uppercase, strip extra spaces, and map to a canonical company name using a lookup table or fuzzy matching.

contamination_risks.description: Some company names may contain non-ASCII characters (e.g., 'Rainbow Children�s Medicare Limited' with a replacement character).
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Decode HTML entities and replace non-ASCII characters with ASCII equivalents.

fields.name: company
fields.notes: The list contains many duplicates and variations (e.g., 'ACME SOLAR HOLDINGS LTD' vs 'ACME Solar Holdings Limited'). Some entries include 'Addendum' or 'Corrigendum' in the name.
fields.semantic: Name of the company as per the offer document filing.

contamination_risks.description: ISIN may be missing (dash) for companies that have not yet been assigned one. Some entries have valid ISINs, others do not.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Treat dash as null. Validate ISIN format (2 letters + 9 alphanumeric + 1 check digit).

contamination_risks.description: ISIN may be added or updated later as the IPO progresses.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Allow updates to ISIN field; do not treat as immutable.

fields.name: isin
fields.notes: Many entries have '-' as placeholder. Valid ISINs are 12-character alphanumeric codes.
fields.null_meaning: A dash '-' indicates that the ISIN is not yet assigned or not available.
fields.semantic: International Securities Identification Number for the company's equity shares.

contamination_risks.description: Symbol is almost always empty in this endpoint. It may be populated in other endpoints.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Treat empty string as null. If needed, join with other endpoints to get symbol.

fields.name: symbol
fields.notes: This field is consistently empty in the observed snapshot. It may be populated for listed companies.
fields.null_meaning: Empty string indicates that the symbol is not yet assigned or not applicable.
fields.semantic: Trading symbol of the company on NSE (usually empty in this list).
